text: APPROVE: the extraction preserves every branch and early exit (the `route`-object case, the chain/non-chain split, the `continue`→`return null` mappings, and `close` was only used for the zero check). The remaining loop is much simpler and `VerbCall` scores about 12 by my estimate. One caveat: I couldn't see the top of the method or confirm that `f.Arguments` returns `List<Span>`, so a compile error from the `List<Span>` parameter or a `result` name clash is the one thing I couldn't rule out.
